lines.en: I walk beside you, never ahead.

lines.zh: 我的膝是折的，步子很特别
lines.en: My knees are folded; my gait is odd.

lines.zh: 我的红鳞在日光下发亮
lines.en: My red scales shine in daylight.
I match my pace to yours.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边用眼角看你
lines.en: I watch you from the corner of my eye as I walk.

lines.zh: 我不再伏低了，我抬着头
lines.en: I no longer crouch; my head is up.
My tail sways gently.

lines.zh: 我走到岔口就停下等你
lines.en: At a fork I stop and wait.
My claws land softly.

lines.zh: 红色的鳞，飞起来最扎眼。
lines.en: Red scales stand out most in flight.
I walk where you point.

lines.zh: 我给脚让出位置，跟在你侧后
lines.en: I keep to your rear flank and give room.

lines.zh: 我一走近，附近的鸟就散了
lines.en: Birds scatter as I approach.

lines.zh: 我停下，回头看你有没有跟上
lines.en: I stop and look back for you.

lines.zh: 我坐在你身后，翅膀收着
lines.en: I sit behind you, wings folded.
My breathing is slow and calm.
I no longer need to watch your hands.
Whatever you are doing, I watch.

lines.zh: 我的红鳞上有一道旧痕
lines.en: An old mark crosses my red scales.
I rest my head against your shoulder.

lines.zh: 风来的时候我挡在你前面
lines.en: When wind comes, I stand in front of you.

lines.zh: 我不用吼，也不需要证明什么
lines.en: I need not roar, nor prove anything.

lines.zh: 我听到远处有动静，抬了抬头
lines.en: I hear something far off and lift my head.
My claws are tucked under me.
I yawn a long yawn.
I wait for you to raise the ring.

lines.zh: 我把前半身贴在地上，很放松
lines.en: I stretch my forebody flat on the ground, relaxed.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，扫起一层灰
lines.en: I flick my tail, raising a little dust.
I lift my head and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你的手一抬，我就知道要做什么
lines.en: When your hand lifts, I know what to do.
You touch my neck; I do not pull away.
I know that ring.
Say stop, and I stop.
Say follow, and I follow.
Say attack, and I attack.
Say ride, and I lower myself.
If you tire, climb on.
I have bitten people before.
It is different now.

lines.zh: 我们之间不用命令也能懂
lines.en: We need no orders to understand each other.
Wherever you go, I go.

lines.zh: 你的气息我闭眼都认得
lines.en: I know your scent with my eyes shut.
I will not growl at you again.

lines.zh: 我退到你身后，又立刻站回来
lines.en: I drop behind you, then step back up.
That tore my scales.

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，不是对你
lines.en: I growl once, and not at you.
Blood drips; I wipe it away.
I can still stand, and still fight.
The wing on this side is heavy.
Step back a little and let me.
I am fine; do not come closer.
Eat first; I am in no hurry.
I would take that meat too.
I lower my head and take it from your hand.
Do not pull back; I bite gently.
After eating I will lick your hand.
Not enough for both of us.
My belly is not empty yet.
Whatever you leave is fine.

lines.zh: 我趴下来，把头放在你膝上
lines.en: I lie down and rest my head on your knee.
I turn aside so I do not hurt you.
My scales are hard; mind yourself.
You lose balance; I brace you with my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得偏了一点
lines.en: That nudged me slightly off.

lines.zh: 我低头看你有没有事，红鳞擦过你肩。
lines.en: I lower my head to check you; red scales brush your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绕了一下，护住你
lines.en: My tail curls around to shield you.
We do not often collide.
I step aside to give you the path.

lines.zh: 你要是摔了，我会先低头
lines.en: If you fall, I duck first.
I choose you, and no other.

lines.zh: 你在我旁边，我就不看别处
lines.en: With you beside me, I look nowhere else.

lines.zh: 我把最暖的一侧留给你
lines.en: I keep my warmest side for you.
At night I sleep at your door.

lines.zh: 你骑我飞的时候，我们是一体的
lines.en: When you ride me in flight, we are one.
I spread my wings only for you.
If you are hurt, I stay and guard.
We need no words to understand.

lines.zh: 你要是走远，我会跟上去
lines.en: If you go far, I follow.
My life is yours now.
I carry it and lower it slowly.
This is for you.
I carry it over and set it by your boot.
My teeth will leave marks.
Too heavy; I dragged it a while.

lines.zh: 这个是从我旧巢里翻的
lines.en: I found this in my old nest.
I have no use for it; take it.
I push it into your hand.
I carried it carefully, unbroken.
You point, and I see it.
I drop low, but not at you.
I can take this one.
My wings open slightly.
Smaller than me; enough.
I do not roar; I strike first.
This will be clean.
Your order is received.
If it touches you, I will not be gentle.

lines.zh: 石柱旁那道影子，就是它
lines.en: That shadow by the pillar; that is it.
I move my foreleg first.
Point again; let me confirm.
It moves; my head follows.
I put myself between it and you.
I keep my breathing quiet.
You are behind me; I will not give ground.
I wait for it to lunge first.
I have its escape route marked.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上扫了一下
lines.en: My tail sweeps the ground once.
I am patient; it cannot get away.
If you are hurt, I will be faster.
Let me get closer.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低到你腰的高度
lines.en: I sink to your waist height.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，很快收回
lines.en: I bite and withdraw at once.
Foreclaw pins, tail sweeps aside.
That one was for you.
I did not let it near you.
Something spattered my scales.
I return and stand before you.

lines.zh: 我咬得很准，没有多余动作
lines.en: My bite was precise, nothing wasted.
It is down; I stop.
My claws are sheathed.
Are you all right? Answer me.
I kept something in reserve.
If it moves, I go again.
I look back at you for a nod.

lines.zh: 我站在你门口，等你出来
lines.en: I stand at your door, waiting for you.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，把灰抖掉
lines.en: I shake my wings to shed the dust.

lines.zh: 我的红鳞上还有旧巢的土
lines.en: Old nest dirt still clings to my red scales.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方飞回来
lines.en: I flew back from far away.
I no longer crouch in stone cracks.

lines.zh: 我落地时很轻，怕惊到你
lines.en: I land softly so as not to startle you.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走了半圈，确认你没事
lines.en: I circle you once to be sure you are well.
The wind here is better than in the ruin.
I lower my head to your hand.
My tail is wagging fast.
I stop beside you.

lines.zh: 我不需要笼子，也不需要链子
lines.en: I need no cage, no chain.

lines.zh: 你叫我的时候，我总会到
lines.en: When you call, I always come.
I settle in your shadow.
I look up at the sky.
Let us go now.
I wait to see which foot you move first.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的鳞，我抖了抖
lines.en: Fire catches my scales; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，砸在地上
lines.en: I fall from height and hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的嘴，我使劲抬头
lines.en: Water floods my mouth; I strain upward.
The blast throws me to your side.
An arrow lodges at my wing base.
That force binds my claws.
I am hungry, but you eat first.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我伏低了
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; I drop low.
No ground; I spread my wings.
